```{r}
# PERCENT SURVIVAL
# Function for summarising survival standard error
summarySE <- function(data=NULL, measurevar=NULL, groupvars=NULL, na.rm=FALSE,
                      conf.interval=.95, .drop=TRUE) {
  require(plyr)
  
  # New version of length which can handle NA's: if na.rm==T, don't count them
  length2 <- function (x, na.rm=FALSE) {
    if (na.rm==TRUE) sum(!is.na(x))
    else       length(x)
  }
  
  # This does the summary. For each group's data frame, return a vector with
  # N, mean, and sd
  datac <- ddply(data, groupvars, .drop=.drop,
                 .fun = function(xx, col) {
                   c(N    = length2(xx[[col]], na.rm=na.rm),
                     mean = mean   (xx[[col]], na.rm=na.rm),
                     sd   = sd     (xx[[col]], na.rm=na.rm)
                   )
                 },
                 measurevar
  )
  
  # Commenting this rename mean column line, as not assigning measurevar name properly
  # # Rename the "mean" column    
  # datac <- rename(datac, measurevar = mean)
  
  datac$se <- datac$sd / sqrt(datac$N)  # Calculate standard error of the mean
  
  # Confidence interval multiplier for standard error
  # Calculate t-statistic for confidence interval: 
  # e.g., if conf.interval is .95, use .975 (above/below), and use df=N-1
  ciMult <- qt(conf.interval/2 + .5, datac$N-1)
  datac$ci <- datac$se * ciMult
  
  return(datac)
}
```

```{r}
theme_Publication <- function(base_size=14, base_family="arial") {
      library(grid)
      library(ggthemes)
      (theme_foundation(base_size=base_size, base_family=base_family)
       + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                         size = rel(1.2), hjust = 0.5),
               text = element_text(),
               panel.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               plot.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               panel.border = element_rect(colour = NA),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = rel(1)),
               axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90,vjust =2),
               axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
               axis.text = element_text(), 
               axis.line = element_line(colour="black"),
               axis.ticks = element_line(),
               panel.grid.major = element_line(colour="#f0f0f0"),
               panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
               legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA),
               legend.position = "bottom",
               legend.direction = "horizontal",
               legend.key.size= unit(0.2, "cm"),
               legend.margin = unit(0, "cm"),
               legend.title = element_text(face="italic"),
               plot.margin=unit(c(10,5,5,5),"mm"),
               strip.background=element_rect(colour="#f0f0f0",fill="#f0f0f0"),
               strip.text = element_text(face="bold")
          ))
      
}
```

```{r}
#Extracting Variance Explained by father and mother
summary(fit_larv)  # Provides summary of fixed and random effects, including SDs for 'father' and 'mother'

posterior_summary(fit_larv, pars = c("sd_Dad__Intercept", "sd_Mom__Intercept"))

#Calculating the Proportion of Variance Explained
icc <- as_draws_df(fit_larv) %>%
  mutate(icc_Dad = sd_Dad__Intercept^2 / 
         (sd_Dad__Intercept^2 + sd_Mom__Intercept^2 + (pi^2 / 3))) %>%
  summarise(mean(icc_Dad))

#Posterior Distribution for Random Effects
a<-ranef(fit_larv)  # Extracts posterior distributions for random effects
dad_cont_larv<-as.data.frame(a$Dad) |> rownames_as_column(var = "Dad")
mom_cont_larv<-as.data.frame(a$Mom)|> rownames_as_column(var = "Mom")
pp_check(fit_larv)  # Visual diagnostic for model fit
```

```{r}
#create column with region of parent
dad_cont_larv <- dad_cont_larv %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Dad) ~ "Central",  # Match 'Davies' or 'Palms' followed by numbers
      grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Dad) ~ "North",       # Match 'Jewell', 'Parke', or 'Switzer'
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Assign NA if none of the conditions match
    )
  )

mom_cont_larv <- mom_cont_larv %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Mom) ~ "Central",  # Match 'Davies' or 'Palms' followed by numbers
      grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Mom) ~ "North",       # Match 'Jewell', 'Parke', or 'Switzer'
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Assign NA if none of the conditions match
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#extract and plot parent contribution
ranef_samples_larv <- as_draws_df(fit_larv)

ranef_summary_larv <- ranef_samples_larv %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("r_Dad"), starts_with("r_Mom")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "term", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    se = sd(value),
    lower_hdi = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper_hdi = quantile(value, 0.975)
  )

# Extract grouping factors
ranef_summary_larv <- ranef_summary_larv %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(grepl("Dad", term), "Dad", "Mom"),
    level = gsub(".*__(.*)", "\\1", term)
  )

#create column with region of parent
ranef_summary_larv <- ranef_summary_larv %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      grepl("*Davies[0-9]+|*Palms[0-9]+", term) ~ "Central",  # Match 'Davies' or 'Palms' followed by numbers
      grepl("*Jewell|*Parke|*Switzer", term) ~ "North",       # Match 'Jewell', 'Parke', or 'Switzer'
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Assign NA if none of the conditions match
    )
  )

ranef_summary_larv <- ranef_summary_larv |>
  mutate(parent = sub(".*\\[(.*?),.*", "\\1", level)) |>
  mutate(parent_sex = paste(parent, group, sep = "_"))

juv_dad_av_larv<- ranef_summary_larv |>
  dplyr::filter(group == "Dad") |>
  group_by(Region) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(mean),
    se = sd(mean))

juv_mum_av_larv<- ranef_summary_larv |>
  dplyr::filter(group == "Mom") |>
  group_by(Region) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(mean),
    se = sd(mean))

# Replace "mom" with "dam" and "dad" with "sire" and factorise
ranef_summary_larv$group <- gsub("Mom", "Dams", ranef_summary_larv$group)
ranef_summary_larv$group <- gsub("Dad", "Sires", ranef_summary_larv$group)
ranef_summary_larv<- ranef_summary_larv |> mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Sires", "Dams")))

# Replace "_mum" with "_m" and "dad" with "_d"
ranef_summary_larv$parent_sex <- gsub("_Mom", "m", ranef_summary_larv$parent_sex)
ranef_summary_larv$parent_sex <- gsub("_Dad", "d", ranef_summary_larv$parent_sex)

larv_cont_plot<- ggplot(ranef_summary_larv, aes(x = reorder(parent_sex, desc(mean)), y = mean, color = Region)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_hdi, ymax = upper_hdi), width = 0.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.1, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(color = "Region") +
  facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free", drop = T, nrow=2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=pal[c(1,5)]) +
  labs(x='Parent', y="ICC")+
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        plot.margin = margin(rep(0.5,4)),
        legend.position="right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")
        ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3),breaks = seq(-3, 3, 1))
larv_cont_plot
```

```{r}
# Extract variances explained by mum and dad
var_dad <- as.numeric(VarCorr(fit_larv)$Dad$sd[1])^2
var_mom <- as.numeric(VarCorr(fit_larv)$Mom$sd[1])^2
var_residual <- pi^2 / 3  # Residual variance on the logit scale for binary outcome

# Calculate variance proportions
prop_var_dad_larv <- var_dad / (var_dad + var_mom + var_residual)
prop_var_mom_larv <- var_mom / (var_dad + var_mom + var_residual)

# Print results
prop_var_dad_larv
prop_var_mom_larv
```

```{r}
# Load necessary function
inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

# Back-transform to predicted survival probability
ranef_summary_larv <- ranef_summary_larv %>%
  mutate(prob = inv_logit(mean))  # converts log-odds to probability

# Calculate mean predicted survival for each region
region_means <- ranef_summary_larv %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_prob = mean(prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_prob = sd(prob, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Calculate % greater survival of North vs Central
north_mean <- region_means$mean_prob[region_means$Region == "North"]
central_mean <- region_means$mean_prob[region_means$Region == "Central"]

X_percent <- ((north_mean - central_mean) / central_mean) * 100
X_percent

```

```{r}
inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

# Posterior draws: intercept and sire REs (iterations x sires)
draws_df <- as_draws_df(fit_larv)
b_int <- as.numeric(dplyr::pull(draws_df, b_Intercept))  # length = n_draws

re_sire_arr <- ranef(fit_larv, summary = FALSE)$Dad[, , "Intercept", drop = FALSE]
sire_levels <- dimnames(re_sire_arr)[[2]]

# Map sire levels to Region (reuse your pattern rules)
sire_regions <- tibble(Dad = sire_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Dad) ~ "Central",
      grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Dad)    ~ "North",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Build predicted probabilities per draw per sire: logit = intercept + sire_RE
# re_sire_mat: n_draws x n_sires
re_sire_mat <- re_sire_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
if (is.vector(re_sire_mat)) re_sire_mat <- matrix(re_sire_mat, ncol = 1)
logit_sire <- sweep(re_sire_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
prob_sire  <- inv_logit(logit_sire)

# Indices by region
idx_north   <- which(sire_regions$Region == "North")
idx_central <- which(sire_regions$Region == "Central")

# Per-draw regional means
north_mean_draws   <- rowMeans(prob_sire[, idx_north,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
central_mean_draws <- rowMeans(prob_sire[, idx_central, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

# Percent difference per draw and summary
x_percent_sire_draws <- (north_mean_draws - central_mean_draws) / central_mean_draws * 100

sire_summary <- tibble(
  mean_percent = mean(x_percent_sire_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
  l95 = quantile(x_percent_sire_draws, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  u95 = quantile(x_percent_sire_draws, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
  north_mean_prob = mean(north_mean_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
  central_mean_prob = mean(central_mean_draws, na.rm = TRUE)
)
sire_summary
```

```{r}
dam_regions <- tibble(Mom = dam_levels) %>%

      grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Mom)    ~ "North",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

re_dam_mat <- re_dam_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
if (is.vector(re_dam_mat)) re_dam_mat <- matrix(re_dam_mat, ncol = 1)
logit_dam <- sweep(re_dam_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
prob_dam  <- inv_logit(logit_dam)

idx_north_d   <- which(dam_regions$Region == "North")
idx_central_d <- which(dam_regions$Region == "Central")

north_mean_draws_d   <- rowMeans(prob_dam[, idx_north_d,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
central_mean_draws_d <- rowMeans(prob_dam[, idx_central_d, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

x_percent_dam_draws <- (north_mean_draws_d - central_mean_draws_d) / central_mean_draws_d * 100

dam_summary <- tibble(
  mean_percent = mean(x_percent_dam_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
  l95 = quantile(x_percent_dam_draws, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  u95 = quantile(x_percent_dam_draws, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
  north_mean_prob = mean(north_mean_draws_d, na.rm = TRUE),
  central_mean_prob = mean(central_mean_draws_d, na.rm = TRUE)
)
dam_summary
```

```{r}
# Summary table

  Group = c("Sires", "Dams"),
  Mean_percent_difference = c(mean(x_percent_sire_draws),

  Lower_95 = c(quantile(x_percent_sire_draws, 0.025),
               quantile(x_percent_dam_draws, 0.025)),
  Upper_95 = c(quantile(x_percent_sire_draws, 0.975),
               quantile(x_percent_dam_draws, 0.975)),
  P_North_greater = c(p_sire, p_dam)
)
```

```{r}
dad_cont_juv<-as.data.frame(a$Dad) |> rownames_as_column(var = "Dad")
mum_cont_juv<-as.data.frame(a$Mum)|> rownames_as_column(var = "Mum")
pp_check(fit_juv)  # Visual diagnostic for model fit
```

```{r}
#create column with region of parent
dad_cont_juv <- dad_cont_juv %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Dad) ~ "Central",  # Match 'Davies' or 'Palms' followed by numbers
      grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Dad) ~ "North",       # Match 'Jewell', 'Parke', or 'Switzer'
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Assign NA if none of the conditions match
    )
  )

mum_cont_juv <- mum_cont_juv %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Mum) ~ "Central",  # Match 'Davies' or 'Palms' followed by numbers
      grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Mum) ~ "North",       # Match 'Jewell', 'Parke', or 'Switzer'
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Assign NA if none of the conditions match
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#extract and plot parent contribution
ranef_samples_juv <- as_draws_df(fit_juv)

ranef_summary_juv <- ranef_samples_juv %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("r_Dad"), starts_with("r_Mum")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "term", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    se = sd(value),
    lower_hdi = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper_hdi = quantile(value, 0.975)
  )

# Extract grouping factors
ranef_summary_juv <- ranef_summary_juv %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(grepl("Dad", term), "Dad", "Mum"),
    level = gsub(".*__(.*)", "\\1", term)
  )

#create column with region of parent
ranef_summary_juv <- ranef_summary_juv %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      grepl("*Davies[0-9]+|*Palms[0-9]+", term) ~ "Central",  # Match 'Davies' or 'Palms' followed by numbers
      grepl("*Jewell|*Parke|*Switzer", term) ~ "North",       # Match 'Jewell', 'Parke', or 'Switzer'
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Assign NA if none of the conditions match
    )
  )

ranef_summary_juv <- ranef_summary_juv |>
  mutate(parent = sub(".*\\[(.*?),.*", "\\1", level)) |>
  mutate(parent_sex = paste(parent, group, sep = "_"))

juv_dad_av_juv<- ranef_summary_juv |>
  dplyr::filter(group == "Dad") |>
  group_by(Region) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(mean),
    se = sd(mean))

juv_mum_av_juv<- ranef_summary_juv |>
  dplyr::filter(group == "Mum") |>
  group_by(Region) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(mean),
    se = sd(mean))

# Replace "mum" with "dam" and "dad" with "sire" and factorise it
ranef_summary_juv$group <- gsub("Mum", "Dams", ranef_summary_juv$group)
ranef_summary_juv$group <- gsub("Dad", "Sires", ranef_summary_juv$group)
ranef_summary_juv<- ranef_summary_juv |> mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Sires", "Dams")))

# Replace "_mum" with "_m" and "dad" with "_d"
ranef_summary_juv$parent_sex <- gsub("_Mum", "m", ranef_summary_juv$parent_sex)
ranef_summary_juv$parent_sex <- gsub("_Dad", "d", ranef_summary_juv$parent_sex)

#plot
juv_cont_plot<- ggplot(ranef_summary_juv, aes(x = reorder(parent_sex, desc(mean)), y = mean, color = Region)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_hdi, ymax = upper_hdi), width = 0.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.1, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(color = "Region") +
  facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free", drop = T, nrow=2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=pal[c(1,5)]) +
  labs(x='Parent', y="ICC")+
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        plot.margin = margin(rep(0.5,4)),
        legend.position="right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")
        ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3),breaks = seq(-3, 3, 1))
juv_cont_plot
```

```{r}
# Extract variances explained by mum and dad
var_dad <- as.numeric(VarCorr(fit_juv)$Dad$sd[1])^2
var_mom <- as.numeric(VarCorr(fit_juv)$Mum$sd[1])^2
var_residual <- pi^2 / 3  # Residual variance on the logit scale for binary outcome

# Calculate variance proportions
prop_var_dad_juv <- var_dad / (var_dad + var_mom + var_residual)
prop_var_mom_juv <- var_mom / (var_dad + var_mom + var_residual)

# Print results
prop_var_dad_juv
prop_var_mom_juv
```

#calculate 
```{r}
# Load necessary function
inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

# Back-transform to predicted survival probability
ranef_summary_juv <- ranef_summary_juv %>%
  mutate(prob = inv_logit(mean))  # converts log-odds to probability

# Calculate mean predicted survival for each region
region_means <- ranef_summary_juv %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_prob = mean(prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_prob = sd(prob, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Calculate % greater survival of North vs Central
north_mean <- region_means$mean_prob[region_means$Region == "North"]
central_mean <- region_means$mean_prob[region_means$Region == "Central"]

X_percent <- ((north_mean - central_mean) / central_mean) * 100
X_percent
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)

inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

# Posterior draws for intercept

draws_df <- as_draws_df(fit_juv)
b_int    <- as.numeric(dplyr::pull(draws_df, b_Intercept))  # length = n_draws

## ---------- Sires (Dad) ----------

re_sire_arr <- ranef(fit_juv, summary = FALSE)$Dad[, , "Intercept", drop = FALSE]
sire_levels <- dimnames(re_sire_arr)[[2]]

sire_regions <- tibble(Dad = sire_levels) %>%
mutate(
Region = case_when(
grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Dad) ~ "Central",
grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Dad)    ~ "North",
TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
)

re_sire_mat <- re_sire_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
if (is.vector(re_sire_mat)) re_sire_mat <- matrix(re_sire_mat, ncol = 1)

logit_sire <- sweep(re_sire_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
prob_sire  <- inv_logit(logit_sire)

idx_north_sire   <- which(sire_regions$Region == "North")
idx_central_sire <- which(sire_regions$Region == "Central")

north_mean_draws_sire   <- rowMeans(prob_sire[, idx_north_sire,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
central_mean_draws_sire <- rowMeans(prob_sire[, idx_central_sire, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

x_percent_sire_draws <- (north_mean_draws_sire - central_mean_draws_sire) /
central_mean_draws_sire * 100

## ---------- Dams (Mum) ----------

re_dam_arr <- ranef(fit_juv, summary = FALSE)$Mum[, , "Intercept", drop = FALSE]
dam_levels <- dimnames(re_dam_arr)[[2]]

dam_regions <- tibble(Mum = dam_levels) %>%
mutate(
Region = case_when(
grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Mum) ~ "Central",
grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Mum)    ~ "North",
TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
)

re_dam_mat <- re_dam_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
if (is.vector(re_dam_mat)) re_dam_mat <- matrix(re_dam_mat, ncol = 1)

logit_dam <- sweep(re_dam_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
prob_dam  <- inv_logit(logit_dam)

idx_north_dam   <- which(dam_regions$Region == "North")
idx_central_dam <- which(dam_regions$Region == "Central")

north_mean_draws_dam   <- rowMeans(prob_dam[, idx_north_dam,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
central_mean_draws_dam <- rowMeans(prob_dam[, idx_central_dam, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

x_percent_dam_draws <- (north_mean_draws_dam - central_mean_draws_dam) /
central_mean_draws_dam * 100

## ---------- Summary in same layout as larvae ----------

p_sire <- mean(x_percent_sire_draws > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
p_dam  <- mean(x_percent_dam_draws  > 0, na.rm = TRUE)

juv_parent_region_summary <- tibble(
Group = c("Sires", "Dams"),
Mean_percent_difference = c(mean(x_percent_sire_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
mean(x_percent_dam_draws,  na.rm = TRUE)),
Lower_95 = c(quantile(x_percent_sire_draws, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
quantile(x_percent_dam_draws,  0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
Upper_95 = c(quantile(x_percent_sire_draws, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
quantile(x_percent_dam_draws,  0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
P_North_greater = c(p_sire, p_dam)
)

juv_parent_region_summary

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)

inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

# Posterior draws (intercept)
draws_df <- as_draws_df(fit_juv)
b_int    <- as.numeric(dplyr::pull(draws_df, b_Intercept))  # length = n_draws

### --- Sires (Dad) --- ###
re_dad_arr <- ranef(fit_juv, summary = FALSE)$Dad[, , "Intercept", drop = FALSE]
dad_levels <- dimnames(re_dad_arr)[[2]]

dad_regions <- tibble(Dad = dad_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Dad) ~ "Central",
      grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Dad)    ~ "North",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

re_dad_mat <- re_dad_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
if (is.vector(re_dad_mat)) re_dad_mat <- matrix(re_dad_mat, ncol = 1)

logit_dad <- sweep(re_dad_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
prob_dad  <- inv_logit(logit_dad)

idx_north_dad   <- which(dad_regions$Region == "North")
idx_central_dad <- which(dad_regions$Region == "Central")

north_mean_draws_dad   <- rowMeans(prob_dad[, idx_north_dad,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
central_mean_draws_dad <- rowMeans(prob_dad[, idx_central_dad, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

percent_diff_dad_draws <- (north_mean_draws_dad - central_mean_draws_dad) /
                           central_mean_draws_dad * 100

sire_summary_juv <- tibble(
  group           = "Sires",
  mean_percent    = mean(percent_diff_dad_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
  l95             = quantile(percent_diff_dad_draws, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  u95             = quantile(percent_diff_dad_draws, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
  p_north_greater = mean(percent_diff_dad_draws > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  north_mean_prob   = mean(north_mean_draws_dad, na.rm = TRUE),
  central_mean_prob = mean(central_mean_draws_dad, na.rm = TRUE)
)

### --- Dams (Mum) --- ###
re_mum_arr <- ranef(fit_juv, summary = FALSE)$Mum[, , "Intercept", drop = FALSE]
mum_levels <- dimnames(re_mum_arr)[[2]]

mum_regions <- tibble(Mum = mum_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      grepl("^Davies[0-9]+|^Palms[0-9]+", Mum) ~ "Central",
      grepl("^Jewell|^Parke|^Switzer", Mum)    ~ "North",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

re_mum_mat <- re_mum_arr[, , 1, drop = TRUE]
if (is.vector(re_mum_mat)) re_mum_mat <- matrix(re_mum_mat, ncol = 1)

logit_mum <- sweep(re_mum_mat, 1, b_int, `+`)
prob_mum  <- inv_logit(logit_mum)

idx_north_mum   <- which(mum_regions$Region == "North")
idx_central_mum <- which(mum_regions$Region == "Central")

north_mean_draws_mum   <- rowMeans(prob_mum[, idx_north_mum,   drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
central_mean_draws_mum <- rowMeans(prob_mum[, idx_central_mum, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

percent_diff_mum_draws <- (north_mean_draws_mum - central_mean_draws_mum) /
                           central_mean_draws_mum * 100

dam_summary_juv <- tibble(
  group           = "Dams",
  mean_percent    = mean(percent_diff_mum_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
  l95             = quantile(percent_diff_mum_draws, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  u95             = quantile(percent_diff_mum_draws, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
  p_north_greater = mean(percent_diff_mum_draws > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  north_mean_prob   = mean(north_mean_draws_mum, na.rm = TRUE),
  central_mean_prob = mean(central_mean_draws_mum, na.rm = TRUE)
)

### --- Combined clean summary table --- ###
juv_parent_region_summary <- bind_rows(sire_summary_juv, dam_summary_juv)
juv_parent_region_summary

```

```{r}
juv_con<- ranef_summary_juv |> dplyr::select(Region, group, parent_sex, mean) |> mutate(Lifestage = "Juvenile")

# Replace "mom" with "mum" in the 'group' column and factorise lifestage

con$group <- gsub("Dad", "Sires", con$group)
```

```{r}
percent_diff <- abs(A - B) / ((abs(A) + abs(B)) / 2) * 100
percent_diff

k <- abs(min(juv_sire$mean)) + 1e-6   # small offset
A2 <- A + k
B2 <- B + k
log_ratio <- log(B2 / A2)
log_ratio
```

Stats for parent contributions
```{r}
#Filter data
lar_dam<- ranef_summary_larv |> filter(group == "Dams")
lar_sire<- ranef_summary_larv |> filter(group == "Sires")
juv_dam<- ranef_summary_juv |> filter(group == "Dams")
juv_sire<- ranef_summary_juv |> filter(group == "Sires")

juv_dam_nor<- juv_dam |> filter(Region == "North")
juv_dam_cen<- juv_dam |> filter(Region == "Central")
juv_sir_nor<- juv_sire |> filter(Region == "North")
juv_sir_cen<- juv_sire |> filter(Region == "Central")

# Check normality (Shapiro-Wilk test)
shapiro.test(lar_dam$mean) # p > 0.05 → normal = 0.19
shapiro.test(lar_sire$mean) # p > 0.05 → normal = 0.02
shapiro.test(juv_dam$mean) # p > 0.05 → normal = 0.61
shapiro.test(juv_sire$mean) # p > 0.05 → normal = 0.99

# Check equal variances (F-test)
var.test(lar_dam$mean, lar_sire$mean) # p > 0.05 → equal variances

# Wilcoxon rank-sum test (non-parametric)
wilcox_dams_juvs_region <- wilcox.test(juv_sir_nor$mean, juv_sir_cen$mean, exact = FALSE)
wilcox_dams_juvs_region
```
